newsitem.title: JAPAN: S'tomo Heavy climbs on laggard purchases.
newsitem.headline: S'tomo Heavy climbs on laggard purchases.

text.p: Shares of Sumitomo Heavy Industries Ltd climbed in the Tuesday afternoon session as investors picked up laggard issues which have fairly high liquidity, brokers said.
As of 0353 GMT, the shares were up two yen at 461. They had hit a calendar year high of 470 yen in the morning.
Turnover was 2.9 million shares. Sumitomo Heavy was the 10th most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

"The firm's group net profits in the year to end-March 1998 are seen rising 26 percent from the previous year," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said. "The issue is a laggard and liquidity is fairly high so investors are attracted to it."
